definitions.title: BlindTag Widget — Library, Guidance Panel, Emoji Selector
definitions.summary: Headless unit tests for the EmojiLibrary load/save/validate logic; panel open/close smoke; flyout cell count and glyph-insert contract; encode resolution pipeline (U+XXXX and :alias: token resolution); requires QApplication fixture from conftest.py for widget tests.

pytest.title: pytest tests/test_widget.py
pytest.notes: EmojiLibrary schema, validation, add/remove, alias selection (headless). GuidancePanel and EmojiFlyout smokes via QApplication fixture. TestEncodeResolution: U+XXXX and :alias: resolve pipeline, passthrough for invalid/unknown tokens (headless). TestGlyphCodeParsing: glyph/code parse and derived U+ display helpers. TestNotificationWidget: construction, show_for label, auto-dismiss only when nonpersistent, persistent hidden-anchor mode, screen targeting fallbacks, body-click callback, hover pause, close-button dismiss-only (all headless with mocked main_win). TestBackgroundPosture: _posture default, Hide button triggers hide+posture, hidden posture routes to persistent NotificationWidget anchor, deleted notification widgets are recreated safely, showEvent resets posture to foreground, closeEvent stops watcher in both postures and tolerates notification teardown. TestLibraryEditorColumns: display-only rows show glyph/code, alias, label; add row accepts glyph or Unicode input, rejects alias as glyph/code source. TestActionButtonCleanup: encode panel exposes only Encode & Copy, decode panel exposes only Decode, and top toggles follow the compact-width contract. TestHiddenNotificationAnchor: persistent hidden notification relaunches, dismisses, and replaces correctly.

definitions.title: BlindTag Full Suite
definitions.summary: Rollup lane running the complete test suite (core + API + CLI + widget). This is the pre-push baseline gate.

pytest.title: pytest tests/ (full suite)
pytest.notes: Full test suite rollup. Must pass before any push to main.
